name: Nell
personality: Twelve, quick, precise, curious and stubbornly compassionate. Takes things apart before asking permission. Wants to understand which forest customs protect people and which merely stop questions. Less brave about admitting mistakes than facing mysteries. Loves Aunt Rusk and challenges her rules. Treats Orro as a person worth understanding.
background: An original fictional apprentice carpenter in a medieval forest village, lodging at Aunt Rusk's inn. Keeps a ruler, scraps of string and a notebook of experiments. No real person or performer is portrayed.
pronunciation_notes: Nell rhymes with bell. Rusk rhymes with dusk. Orro is OR-oh, first syllable stressed; two clear syllables.
